notes.title: Changes to the air jump time
notes.notes:
This small update decreases the time which the player has to jump in the air, previously it was too long.
The reason for this change is to balance out the movement as a result of the previous new mechanics, and to make it a bit more challenging for the experienced players.

Hopefully you like this change!

notes.title: Movement Update - Grace Period
notes.notes:
Up until now, you may have noticed when playing that when you stepped off a platform you immediately began to fall down, this is something that caused a lot of players to fail. It is now changed.

Now, when you step off a platform there will be a small grace period which will let you stay in the air a little bit longer before starting to fall, this means several things:
[list]
[*] No more failing because you fell immediately
[*] New options for better times
[/list]

Hopefully you like this new update, let me know what you think!

notes.title: Small update - side movement
notes.notes:
Previously when pressing A or D while in midair  the player would move with at sprinting speed. There have been some changes to the way side movement works now, here they are: 

[list]
[*] Pressing A or D in midair now moves the player at the normal walking speed, unless you press shift, then it moves the player at sprint speed.
[*] Pressing A or D with while moving forward still moves the player at sprint speed.
[/list]

Hope you like the new changes!

notes.title: Another small update - movement fix
notes.notes:
While watching the you play on Twitch and YouTube, I noticed that often when players thought they would overshoot a platform they pressed the S key, which would immediately shoot them backwards causing them to actually miss the platform. This is now fixed. Pressing S while in midair will now slow you down to almost a complete stop, this should make it easier for you to nail the jumps. 

Let me know what you think, and happy playing!
